steps.action: C31 register an Entity with identity details, then save individual Overview edits
steps.actual: Register saved legal name, live type, formation date, jurisdiction and registration number; Tax ID saved on blur; Dormant Status saved without archiving

steps.action: C31 duplicate names create distinct Entities; missing legal name is refused
steps.actual: A second browser registration with the same legal name created a distinct Entity; blank-name request was refused, so no deduplication or merge is claimed

steps.action: C31 choose Our entity and create, reuse, promote and remove Counterparties
steps.actual: Our entity saved the internal Entity; inline create added two external Counterparties, Primary moved, removing it promoted the remaining party, and reuse returned the same shared Counterparty without a duplicate

steps.action: C32 archive and restore an in-use Entity without losing identity or its Contract reference
steps.actual: In-use Entity archived immediately, disabled editing and refused direct edits without removing its Contract reference; Show archived exposed it and Restore retained Dormant status and returned editing
